commits.message: Delete Platform_Documentation.docx
Add support for multiple slaves in RangingNode

Add ranging frame to RangingNode

Ranging frames encapsulate all the ranging-related allowing more transparent management

Add support for remote targets

Deployment can now flash remote targets (PiZero + IMST282A) through ftp.

Create new project RangingNode

RangingNode provides a multilateration-ready ranging firmware
Corrections in RangingDemo to support NUCLEO_L476RG antenna switch
Add support for STM32L151xBA and IMST282A in mbed-os

Add a filter library + implement filters and fei correction in Ranging Demo

Add a full implementation of moving median filters
Add ranging fei correction tables in Ranging Demo

Add an Advanced Ranging mode to RangingDemo

Third ranging board connected to PC will  start in advanced ranging mode and compute differential ranging while listening to the 2 other boards
Formatting README
Correct README.md
Merge branch 'main' of https://github.com/Hedwyn/Poucet_LCIS_LoRa24 into main
Update README
Delete Lora24_firmware/BUILD directory

Switching project to ARM Mbed 6 with Mbed client 1

Makefiles have bene replaced with mbed client profiles. I/O Serial functions et timers upgraded to Mbed 6 in LoRa 2.4 firmware

Adding FSM library

Implementation of a FSM class to handle the ranging state machine.

Separate Master and Slave FSM

Master and slaves FSM have been isolated in independant functions

Fixed transitions outside FSM

Transitions were triggered by RX-TX interrupts. Interrupts behavior has been changed. A enum-type flag is enabled by each interruption. Flags are checked during the IDLE state which now takes care of the transition

Fix ranging address extraction

The byte ordering given in SX1280 documentation was wrong, leading to address bytes being shuffled
Add address extraction in differential ranging mode

Add Advanced Ranging Mode

Adding Advanced Ranging Support in SX1280 class.
SetAdvancedRanging() to enable
DisableAdvancedRanging() to disable
A boolean keeps track of advanced ranging state (on/off)
Initial commit
